caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle or crib with a dark brown walnut finish, positioned at an angle so that both side panels and the end panels are visible. The crib has decorative, curved cutouts on the top edges of the short end panels and scrolled detailing along the feet, which are designed to rock back and forth. The base, sides, and ends appear to be made out of solid wood with visible wood grain texture, rendered in varying shades of brown. The object is placed on a plain, light, off-white background, with no other objects or designs present. In the bottom right corner, there is text that reads "WALNUT CRIB" and the artist's name, written in small, faint letters.
title: Walnut Crib
